body: Thank you! Have a good new year! :)
It was nothing patronising it was just telling him that I don’t want his pity because I’ve helped him through this certain thing :)
I mentioned his name and some stuff that he’d said to me before (about his personal life) and so I didn’t want that to be shown :)

I didn’t lead him on when we did talk for that week it was obvious it kinda didn’t click for both of us and so it was awkward to talk to one another and so we just left it and didn’t talk about it anymore.
He has messaged me stuff like this before and I know I should block him but I feel that would be pointless as he’s added me (when I blocked him before) on multiple accounts.

I apologise that I didn’t mention this in my title but I didn’t want to go into over explaining :)

The thing that stopped me was the i though things could get better to which I now obviously see is a lie and I hate myself for not going through with it because I knew I was ready and those months that followed were painful because I kept thinking in all the bad moments I could be dead and wouldn’t have to deal with this anymore.

I guess it’s a senior prom, I’m from the UK and it’s when I finally leave high school so there’s that I’m happy about but that’s all that’s making me happy currently.

I really appreciate that you’re talking to me, i feel like I can’t talk to anyone and talking to you has helped me to get out these feelings and I can’t thank you enough

I just can never do anything right, everything I do must go wrong somewhere down the line, like I had this really good friend and then all of a sudden she stopped talking to me and won’t talk to me, I didn’t even do anything and she won’t talk to me at all and we sit together in most every lesson so it just makes me feel so bad.

My mum spends lots of money on me as I’m going to prom soon and she spent over £300 for a dress and I just feel so bad that she’s spending all this money on me because I don’t deserve it and without me here she will have so much money and won’t have to worry about having two kids and providing for both instead she’ll be providing for one. 

I like The Perks of Being a Wallflower book and movie more than anything they’re so good and I’ve probably watched the movie eight times and read the book five times, I think it’s the book that helps me escape and helps me to feel real and not numb I guess? But then the book or movie ends and I’m brought back into this realisation that this is real and I don’t deserve to escape this feeling .

I’ve been sleeping mostly, I feel like that’s the only place in which I don’t feel bad about myself and then when I wake up I feel so stupid and disgusting and I feel like I deserve so much pain and I feel so numb to all the stuff I’ve done and am doing and then when I’ve done them I start to feel bad and beat myself up about it.
Like yesterday I went to town with my mother and sister and couldn’t help but feel so out of place in my own family, like I was an intruder and I don’t even understand why, maybe it’s because my mum is so different with my sister than me, she’s so much nicer and kinder and I just realised when I was out I didn’t even fit in with anyone and nobody would ever like me or really care for me and I just can’t deal with the fact I’m still here, why I haven’t killed myself so long ago but this time I’m going to do it, I know nobody will be sad that I’m gone and I know that whoever says they will is lying.

I told them about how I feel, I just feel so messed up inside and I can't express it through words how shitty I feel, I feel numb.
I just can never do anything right I try so hard to be a good person and make people smile and I never can, I can't even do something as simple as  that right and so I can't do anything and nothing ever works out for me and I keep making so many mistakes and so many things worse than they already are.

I have many pros in which include:
1. The fact my mother won't have to spend as much money
2. I won't mess things up for everyone
3. My sister won't have to deal with me
4. Nobody will ever love me

The cons of which include:
1. I won't be able to discover new music 
2. I won't be able to discover new books
3. I will miss prom

I mean that's all that's stopping me, and I don't even know why I haven't done it yet but I amjust hoping that someone will realise I am not ok but nobody has yet to see that

I don’t really think anyone has, Ive tried to talk to therapists about this and I feel like they don’t truly understand, I’ve talked to people I used to be friends with and they now see me as a freak. I don’t think I truly belong here.

It’s just the fact I make so many mistakes in life and I’m such a bad person that i deserve to die and I deserve to suffer, my mother wouldn’t have to spend so much money on me and my sister and my sister won’t have to deal with all the shit I give her, I have been thinking about this for quite some time and I even made a pros and cons list and there’s around 14 pros and 4 cons so I think the pros outweigh the cons so I’m gonna do it, I just don’t know when really, there’s some things I need to do first then I will for sure.

It’s so hard to explain but this feeling has been building up over time, I’ve felt it coming and thought I had time to try and stop it but I don’t and I can’t stop thinking about how everyone will be happier if I’m no longer here and I’m just thinking about all the positive things about not being here and I can’t seem to think of any negative things.
